questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — highest total of 420, against Boland on 2019/02/02.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Matches Played' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Nonkhululeko Thabethe holds it, with a total of 154.

questions.question: Alysia Rudolph set a database record (20/21 season, List A) with a value of 16. Which record is it?
options: Best Bowling Figures in an Innings
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Maidens', held by Alysia Rudolph.

Which player is the only one in this database's history to score 200+ runs AND take 3+ wickets in the same match?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade is the sole member of the 200-run/3-wicket club, achieving it in a single match against Kei on 10 February 2018 (212 runs, 3 for 26).
